description: This file defines the ActivateTrigger class, a Unity MonoBehaviour script that triggers actions on game objects when a collider is entered. It supports multiple modes such as triggering, replacing, activating, enabling, animating, and deactivating target objects.

classes.name: ActivateTrigger
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour script that performs various actions on game objects when triggered by collider events.

methods.name: DoActivateTrigger
methods.description: Performs the action specified by the mode on the target game object when triggered.

methods.name: OnTriggerEnter
methods.description: Unity callback invoked when another collider enters the trigger collider, which then calls DoActivateTrigger.
